data.title: Backward Bunny Hops
data.description: Learn to subtract numbers by hopping backward on a number line.

challenges.instruction: Place a point at 2 on the number line.
challenges.hint: Look between the 1 and the 3 to find your spot.

challenges.instruction: Can you find and place a point on the number line to show 6?
challenges.hint: Look at the number 5, and take one big hop forward to the very next tick mark.

challenges.instruction: Can you show me where the number 5 lives on our number line today?
challenges.hint: Look right in the middle between 4 and 6 to find your spot!

challenges.instruction: Can you find where the number 4 lives on our number line and place a point right there?
challenges.hint: Start at 5 and take one little hop backward to find your target!

challenges.instruction: Can you find where the number 3 lives on our number line? Place your point right there!
challenges.hint: Try counting backward 2 steps from the number 5 to see where you land.
